title: #81 Part-time Jobs
prompt: What are the advantages and disadvantages for students doing part-time jobs?

promptSegments.text: What are the advantages and disadvantages for students doing part-time jobs?

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.

promptTraps.en: Do not answer only the first question while neglecting the second requirement; address both dimensions equally.
